# MyEmailVerifier

MyEmailVerifier checks individual email addresses for deliverability and risk signals such as disposable, role-based, catch-all, and greylisted status.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/myemailverifier/.

## Actions

- **Verify Email**: Verify one email address for deliverability and return MyEmailVerifier's status, diagnosis, and risk flags.
- **Verify Emails**: Verify 1 to 5 email addresses serially and return one ordered outcome per input.
